subject: [PATCH v1 00/27] Convert server-side NFSv2 XDR to use xdrgen

reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: Identified two separate patch series that were sent as part of this series, suggesting they be reviewed separately. Expressed willingness to review the main series in detail and acknowledged it with an Acked-by.
